name: Mobility
benefit:
You get a +4 dodge bonus to Armor Class against attacks of opportunity caused when you move out of or within a threatened area. A condition that makes you lose your Dexterity bonus to Armor Class (if any) also makes you lose dodge bonuses.

 Dodge bonuses stack with each other, unlike most types of bonuses.
## Combat Trick (from the Combat Stamina feat)
**Source** Pathfinder Unchained pg. 127
Your dodge bonus to AC from the Dodge feat combat trick is doubled against attacks of opportunity provoked by movement. If you don’t have the Dodge feat, you can still use its combat trick.
flavor: You can easily move through a dangerous melee.
